question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

Rohan __got his birthday gift in the twilight__.

options.text: received his birthday present at dusk
received his birthday present in the dawn
received his birthday present in the genesis
received his birthday present in the morning

solution:
The correct answer is: "**received his birthday present at dusk**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Twilight**" refers to the period of time between daylight and darkness, also known as dusk.
 
• The word "**received**" is a more appropriate verb to use in this context than "**got**."
 
• It provides a more precise and accurate description of when Rohan received his birthday gift.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**received his birthday present in the dawn**" is incorrect because "dawn" refers to the period of time before sunrise, not after sunset.
 
• "**received his birthday present in the genesis**" is incorrect because "genesis" means the beginning or origin of something, and does not make sense in this context.
 
• "**received his birthday present in the morning**" is incorrect because it does not accurately reflect the time of day that Rohan received his gift.
